decoder: round half up to grid, diagonal-first eight-neighbor anchor segments, loop erasure, check every graph edge
initialization: direct, axis-corner and fixed map-rim templates, remaining particles uniform random; no graph search
memory: legal pbest and gbest update only for strictly shorter feasible paths; infeasible guide stored separately
early_stop: feasible path reaches octile analytic lower bound
cache: exact observed graph identity and integer start/goal only
failure: keep executable retained prefix, hold unplanned tail without reassignment or Astar fallback, retry only on normal replanning events
bounds: clip positions to map ranges, clamp each velocity component, fixed worst-current-particle restarts preserve feasible pbest
